spans.s: हैम (I) a. (f. मी) 1. Cold, frigid, wintry, मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागम् R.xvi.7; 2. golden, पादेन हैमं विलिलेखा पीठम् R.vi.15, Bt.v.89.
हैम (III) m. An epithet of Śiva.
हैम (I) a. (f. मी) 1. Cold, frigid, wintry, मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागम् R.xvi.7; 2. golden, पादेन हैमं विलिलेखा पीठम् R.vi.15, Bt.v.89.
हैमन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Wintry, Kir.xvii.12; 2. rowing in winter, suitable for winter, हैमनैर्निवसनैः सुमध्यमाः R.xix.41; 3. golden, made of gold.
हैमन (II) m. 1. The month Mārgaśīrṣa; 2. one of the six seasons of the year. See हेमंत.
हैमन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Wintry, Kir.xvii.12; 2. rowing in winter, suitable for winter, हैमनैर्निवसनैः सुमध्यमाः R.xix.41; 3. golden, made of gold.
हैमंतिक a. (f. की) 1. Winter, cold; 2. growing in winter.
हैमंतिक a. (f. की) 1. Winter, cold; 2. growing in winter.
हैमल m. The same as हैमंत q.v.
हैमवत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Snowy; 2. flowing from the Himālaya mountain, R.xvi.44; 3. bred in or belonging to the Himālaya mountain, R.ii.67, K.S.iii.23.
हैमवत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Snowy; 2. flowing from the Himālaya mountain, R.xvi.44; 3. bred in or belonging to the Himālaya mountain, R.ii.67, K.S.iii.23.
हैमवती f. 1. An epithet of Pārvatī; 2. of the river Ganges; 3. a kind of myrobalan; 4. a tawny grape.
